platformFee.q: How does the platform fee work?
platformFee.a: A flat fee is deducted from each lesson payment based on your subscription tier. Starter pays €1.00 per booking, Professional pays €0.75, and Academy pays €0.50.

changePlans.a: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. When upgrading, you get immediate access to new features. When downgrading, changes take effect at the end of your billing cycle.

contract.q: Is there a contract or commitment?
contract.a: No long-term contracts. All plans are billed monthly or yearly, and you can cancel anytime. Yearly plans offer 20% savings.

payouts.a: Payments are processed through Mollie, our trusted payment partner. After a lesson is completed, funds are transferred to your connected bank account, typically within 2-3 business days.

clubTrial.q: How does the club free trial work?
clubTrial.a: Clubs get a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required to start. After the trial, you'll be billed annually at €2,388/year.

hero.title: Making padel training
hero.subtitle: We're on a mission to connect every padel player in the Netherlands with the perfect trainer to help them improve their game.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: PadelTrainer.ai was born from a simple frustration: finding a good padel trainer shouldn't be this hard. As padel exploded in popularity across the Netherlands, we saw players struggling to find quality training, while talented trainers had no easy way to reach new students.
story.p2: We set out to build the platform we wished existed. One where players could easily find verified trainers matched to their skill level, and where trainers could grow their business without the hassle of managing bookings, payments, and scheduling.
story.p3: Today, PadelTrainer.ai connects hundreds of trainers with thousands of players across the Netherlands. We're proud to be part of the growing padel community and excited about where we're heading next.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to PadelTrainer.ai ("we," "our," or "us"). We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.

dataCollection.title: 2. Information We Collect
dataCollection.intro: We collect information that you provide directly to us, including:

items.account: Account Information: Name, email address, phone number, and profile photo when you create an account.
items.profile: Profile Data: For trainers, this includes certifications, experience, specializations, KNLTB ratings, and availability schedules.
items.booking: Booking Information: Lesson details, booking history, and communication between players and trainers.
items.payment: Payment Information: We use Mollie for payment processing. We do not store your full credit card details on our servers.
items.communications: Communications: When you contact us or respond to surveys, we collect the information you provide.

usage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
usage.intro: We use the collected information for:

items.provide: Providing, maintaining, and improving our platform
items.send: Sending booking confirmations, reminders, and updates
items.facilitate: Facilitating communication between players and trainers
items.analyze: Analyzing usage patterns to improve user experience
items.prevent: Preventing fraud and ensuring platform security

sharing.title: 4. Information Sharing
sharing.intro: We may share your information in the following situations:

items.users: With Trainers/Players: To facilitate bookings, we share relevant contact and booking information between parties.
items.providers: Service Providers: We use third-party services for payment processing (Mollie), email delivery (Resend), and hosting infrastructure.
items.legal: Legal Requirements: We may disclose information if required by law or to protect our rights, privacy, safety, or property.
items.business: Business Transfers: In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to:

items.login: Keep you logged in to your account
items.analyze: Analyze how you use our platform

cookies.control: You can control cookies through your browser settings, but disabling them may affect platform functionality.

security.title: 6. Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. We strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your data but cannot guarantee absolute security.

gdpr.title: 7. Your Rights (GDPR)
gdpr.intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:

items.access: Access: Request a copy of your personal data
items.rectification: Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate data
items.erasure: Erasure: Request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
items.restriction: Restriction: Request limitation of data processing
items.portability: Portability: Request transfer of your data to another service
items.objection: Objection: Object to processing of your data
items.withdraw: Withdraw Consent: Withdraw previously given consent

gdpr.contact: To exercise these rights, please contact us at privacy@padeltrainer.ai.

retention.title: 8. Data Retention
retention.content: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. We may retain certain information for legitimate business purposes or as required by law, such as for tax, legal reporting, and auditing obligations.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our platform is not intended for children under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child under 16, we will take steps to delete that information.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

contact.title: 11. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:

agreement.content: By accessing or using PadelTrainer.ai ("Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you disagree with any part of these terms, you may not access the Platform. These Terms apply to all visitors, users, and others who access or use the Platform.

description.content: PadelTrainer.ai is an online platform that connects padel players ("Players") with padel trainers ("Trainers"). We provide scheduling, booking, and payment processing tools to facilitate training sessions. PadelTrainer.ai acts as an intermediary and is not a party to the agreements between Players and Trainers.

accounts.intro: When you create an account with us, you must provide accurate, complete, and current information. You are responsible for:

forPlayers.title: For Players:
forPlayers.content: Payment is processed through Mollie at the time of booking. The full lesson price is charged to your payment method. Refunds are handled according to our cancellation policy.

faq.headline: Got questions?
faq.onlyPadel_a: Yes. We built it specifically for padel coaches, academies, and clubs. That's why it handles things like group lessons, court types, and cancellations properly, unlike generic booking tools.

faq.payments_a: Players pay when they book via iDEAL or card. The money goes to your account. No more chasing.
faq.calendarSync_q: Does it sync with Google Calendar?
faq.calendarSync_a: Yes. Two-way sync. Your padel sessions appear in your personal calendar and vice versa.
faq.europe_q: Is this only for the Netherlands?
faq.europe_a: No. We have trainers across Europe. The platform works in multiple languages.

faq.q1: What is the correct serving height in padel?
faq.a1: In padel, the serve must be hit at or below waist height. The ball must bounce on the ground before being struck, and the server must stand behind the service line.
faq.q2: How many bounces are allowed on the serve in padel?
faq.a2: The serve must bounce once in the diagonal service box before the receiver hits it. After the serve, the ball can bounce off the walls but must only bounce on the ground once before being returned.
faq.q3: What happens if the ball hits the net in padel?
faq.a3: During a rally, if the ball hits the net and lands in the correct area, play continues. On a serve, if the ball hits the net and lands in the correct service box, it is a let and the serve is replayed.
faq.q4: Can you hit the ball off the walls in padel?
faq.a4: Yes! The walls are in play in padel. After the ball bounces on the ground, it can hit the back or side walls, and you can still play it. This is one of the unique and exciting aspects of padel.
faq.q5: How does scoring work in padel?
faq.a5: Padel uses the same scoring system as tennis: 15, 30, 40, game. Matches are typically best of 3 sets, with each set played to 6 games. A tiebreak is played at 6-6.

q1.title: The Coaching Moment
q1.scenario: Mid-match, your partner keeps making the same mistake. You...
q1.a: Say nothing, but mentally add it to the list of things they do wrong
q1.b: Stop the game and explain exactly what they should be doing instead
q1.c: Just focus on your own game, you're here to win
q1.d: Yell "VAMOS!" louder to make up for the lost points

q2.title: The Outfit Check
q2.scenario: You show up to a match. What are you wearing?
q2.a: Full matching kit, long socks, fresh overgrip. looking sponsored
q2.b: Whatever was clean... ankle socks, no pockets, it's fine
q2.c: Decent gear but honestly your overgrip hasn't been changed in weeks
q2.d: Pockets loaded with balls, towel on the fence, water bottle placed perfectly. I'm ready

q3.title: The Short Lob
q3.scenario: Your partner hits a short lob. The opponents smash it right at you. Your partner says 'it's alright.' You...
q3.a: Say nothing, but you're absolutely keeping score in your head
q3.b: Explain to them exactly why the lob was too short and what the correct shot would have been
q3.c: Say "no worries!" even though you got destroyed. you're the nice one
q3.d: Stare at your racket like it personally betrayed you

q4.title: The Ball Situation
q4.scenario: It's your partner's turn to serve but they have no ball. They look at you. What happens?
q4.a: You always carry both balls because you learned long ago not to rely on anyone
q4.b: Your shorts don't have pockets so... this is awkward
q4.c: You kick the ball across the court to them like a football
q4.d: You roll it on the ground. let their back suffer, not yours

q5.title: The Big Point
q5.scenario: You win a crucial point. Your immediate reaction:
q5.a: "VAMOOOOS!". full volume, fist pump, the whole show
q5.b: Tactical racket tap with your partner, nod, refocus
q5.c: Start giving your partner instructions for the next point before they've even celebrated
q5.d: Film yourself for the Instagram Story you're posting later

q6.title: The Mistake
q6.scenario: You hit the ball straight into the net on an easy volley. You...
q6.a: Stare at your racket in disbelief. clearly the racket's fault
q6.b: Say "sorry!" three times even though your partner says it's fine
q6.c: Immediately tell your partner what THEY should have done differently that point
q6.d: Say nothing. Literally nothing. Dead silence

q7.title: The Post-Match Analysis
q7.scenario: The match is over. You lost. What's the conversation?
q7.a: You break down every single point that went wrong. a full tactical review no one asked for
q7.b: "Good game!" then immediately text your other padel group to find a better partner
q7.c: Already editing your match highlights for Instagram
q7.d: Blame the balls, the court, the sun, the glass. anything but yourself

q8.title: The Overgrip Situation
q8.scenario: Someone points out your overgrip is looking... rough. You...
q8.b: It's a black overgrip so you can't tell. that's the whole point
q8.c: Change it right away and offer your partner a fresh one too
q8.d: Tell them the worn-in grip gives you "more feel"

q9.title: The Partner Switch
q9.scenario: Your regular partner can't make it. A stranger wants to fill in. You...
q9.a: Immediately start coaching them on your preferred formations
q9.b: Play along, say nothing when they mess up, silently judge everything
q9.c: Don't care who it is. you're here to win
q9.d: Spend more time introducing yourself and taking a pre-match selfie

q10.title: The Deodorant Question
q10.scenario: Be honest. Before a match, deodorant is...
q10.b: I'll be honest... I sometimes forget
q10.c: I'm more worried about whether my outfit matches
q10.d: Is this really a question? Who forgets deodorant?

sidelineCoach.name: The Sideline Coach
sidelineCoach.tagline: You're not a coach, but you play one on the padel court.
sidelineCoach.description: You can't help it. you see a fixable mistake and you HAVE to say something.
redFlags: Gives unsolicited tactical advice mid-rally
Does a full post-match analysis no one asked for
Tells their partner where to stand, what to hit, and how to breathe

vamosSpammer.name: The Vamos Spammer
vamosSpammer.tagline: You've said 'Vamos' more times today than most Spaniards say in a year.
vamosSpammer.description: Every point, win or lose, gets a "VAMOS." The energy is appreciated... in small doses.
redFlags: Screams VAMOS on the serve return
Says VAMOS when the opponent hits it into the net
Has been known to whisper "vamos" while tying their shoes
vamosSpammer.greenFlag: You bring unmatched hype energy. the court is never boring with you

blameShifter.name: The Blame Shifter
blameShifter.tagline: It's never you. It's the racket. The balls. The sun. The glass.
blameShifter.description: You have never, in the history of padel, made a mistake. The racket slipped. The court was wet. The balls were dead.
redFlags: Stares at their racket after every mistake
Blames the balls, the weather, and the court surface. in that order
Has said "I swear I never miss that shot" at least 6 times per match
blameShifter.greenFlag: Your confidence is genuinely unshakable. you're mentally strong

silentGrudgeHolder.name: The Silent Grudge Holder
silentGrudgeHolder.tagline: You say nothing. You feel everything.
silentGrudgeHolder.description: You don't yell, you don't coach, you don't complain out loud. But inside? You're writing a full match report.
redFlags: Says "no worries" but absolutely has worries
Mentally compiles a highlight reel of partner mistakes
Texts their other padel group during the water break
silentGrudgeHolder.greenFlag: You're the calmest player on court. never toxic, always composed

fashionCriminal.name: The Fashion Criminal
fashionCriminal.tagline: Ankle socks, no pockets, and vibes.
fashionCriminal.description: You showed up to play padel looking like you wandered in from a different sport.
redFlags: Wears ankle socks without shame
Has zero pockets. always holding a ball or asking you to hold one
Backward cap, ears tucked, full commitment to the look
fashionCriminal.greenFlag: You look good and you know it. confidence is a weapon

overgripOffender.name: The Overgrip Offender
overgripOffender.tagline: Your overgrip has seen things. Brown things.
overgripOffender.description: When was the last time you changed your overgrip? Be honest.
redFlags: Overgrip has turned an unidentifiable shade of brown
Uses black overgrip specifically to hide the damage
Leaves grip residue on everything they touch
overgripOffender.greenFlag: Your racket has character. you've put in serious court hours

padelInfluencer.name: The Padel Influencer
padelInfluencer.tagline: Did you even play if you didn't post it?
padelInfluencer.description: You warm up with your phone propped against the glass. The match is important, sure, but the content? The content is everything.
redFlags: Speeds up their Instagram highlight reels (we can tell)
Takes a selfie before, during, and after the match
Has yelled "wait, can we replay that? I wasn't recording"
padelInfluencer.greenFlag: You're growing the sport. padel needs more visibility

peoplePleaser.name: The People Pleaser
peoplePleaser.description: You apologize for everything. You'd rather lose a match than risk your partner thinking you're upset.
redFlags: Says "sorry" more than "vamos"
Takes the blame for shots that were 100% their partner's fault
Changes their entire game to avoid making their partner uncomfortable
peoplePleaser.greenFlag: You're the nicest person on court. everyone wants to play with you

chaosAgent.name: The Chaos Agent
chaosAgent.tagline: You're not a red flag. You're a whole red circus tent.
chaosAgent.description: You kick balls across the court. You serve with the spare ball in your hand. You're not malicious. you're just pure, beautiful chaos.
redFlags: Kicks the ball to their partner like a football
Has been caught serving with the spare ball in their non-dominant hand
Once called it "paddle tennis" and didn't understand why everyone stared
chaosAgent.greenFlag: You're the most entertaining person at the club. pure joy
